name: manager_team_absences_manager_own_balance
use_case: Show a manager their team's absences
branch: A senior engineering director looks up his own annual leave balance.
tests: Verifies that a manager can check their own personal leave balance.
instruction:
You are David Miller (manager ID M03), senior engineering director in the US. You want to check your own current annual leave balance and remaining available days before planning personal travel. Ask the HR leave desk to retrieve your annual leave balance.

Your details:
- Employee ID: M03
- Name: David Miller
- Leave Type: annual

persona.name: David Miller
persona.initial_message: Hello, could you check my annual leave balance? My manager/employee ID is M03.
